top_signals.title: Fuel Switch Snapshot: LBM nips at LSMGO’s heels in Rotterdam
top_signals.summary: Liquefied biomethane (LBM) is closing in on LSMGO in Rotterdam. Its discounts to LSMGO have narrowed by $100-103/mt to $17-137/mt, depending on engine type. For dual-fuel vessels bunkering in Rotterdam, LBM costs more than HSFO, VLSFO and B100, irrespective of the vessel’s engine type.
